description: This file contains extension methods for DaemonSetLister to retrieve DaemonSets associated with Pods and ControllerRevisions, including logic for label selection and filtering.

classes.name: daemonSetLister
classes.description: A lister interface for DaemonSets, extended with methods to find DaemonSets related to Pods and ControllerRevisions.

methods.name: GetPodDaemonSets
methods.description: Returns DaemonSets that potentially match a given Pod based on labels and namespace.

methods.name: GetHistoryDaemonSets
methods.description: Returns DaemonSets that potentially match a given ControllerRevision based on labels and namespace.
